sources.title: Meta and Microsoft Introduce the Next Generation of Llama
sources.evidence: Dated July 18, 2023; announces immediate availability of Llama 2 pretrained and conversational model weights and starting code.

sources.title: Llama-2-70b-hf official model card
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27, 2026. Explicitly identifies this repository as the 70B pretrained model converted to Transformers and lists the released 7B/13B/70B parameter sizes. Lists Meta as developer, text input/output, 4k context and GQA; distinguishes Chat variants. The published size is nominal, and the card does not separately give an active count. Weights require license acceptance.

sources.title: Original Llama 2 model card, llama_v2 branch
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27, 2026. Documents the Llama 2 family, pretrained and tuned variants, text-only modalities, custom license, and the 70B Params row with 4k context and GQA. Does not separately define active parameter counts.

sources.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27, 2026. Introduction and Table 1 explicitly publish the released Llama 2 7B, 13B and 70B parameter variants. Full-paper searches found no separately reported active/activated parameter count. Section 2.2 describes standard Transformer, RMSNorm, SwiGLU and RoPE. Appendix A.2.1 specifies 4096-token context and GQA for 70B. Section 5.1 tool-emergence examples concern Llama 2-Chat, not the base checkpoint.

sources.title: Llama 2 reference Transformer implementation
sources.evidence: TransformerBlock uses attention plus a single three-projection SwiGLU feed-forward network; every block runs in the forward path, without an expert router. Token embeddings and output projection are separate modules; RoPE and KV caches are computed tensors. No checkpoint count was derived.

sources.title: Llama 2 Community License Agreement
sources.evidence: Names the custom Llama 2 Community License and explicitly states the version release date July 18, 2023; grants conditional use and redistribution rights for model materials including weights.

sources.title: Llama 2 original release and inference README
sources.evidence: Documents released weights, license-gated downloads, 70B inference, maximum 4096-token sequences, and that pretrained models are text-completion models not fine-tuned for chat or Q&A.

sources.title: Exact Llama-2-70b-hf configuration (access restricted)
sources.evidence: Unauthenticated direct request returned HTTP 401 requiring approved access. No gated content or weight tensors were downloaded; exact config and checkpoint count are not claimed.

sources.title: Mixtral of Experts — Tables 2 and 4
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27, 2026. Section 3 Table 2 explicitly labels its column Active Params and gives LLaMA 2 70B a value of 70B; Table 4 repeats that value. These are base-model benchmark comparisons, separately from Section 4 instruction fine-tuning and its Llama 2 70B Chat comparison. This establishes Mistral's published nominal active-count convention for the exact base model; it is not a Meta activation disclosure or an exact tensor-participation census.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V2 — Figure 1(a), MMLU versus activated parameters
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27, 2026 and visually inspected Figure 1(a). The axis is Activated Parameters (Billions), with the explicitly labeled LLaMA 2 70B point at approximately 70B. This independently corroborates the nominal comparison convention at plot precision; it does not supply a more precise count or a Meta-authored disclosure.

name.note: Exact 70B pretrained variant; excludes Chat, Llama 1 65B and later Llama generations.

developer.note: Official model cards identify Meta as the developer.

family.note: Normalized family identifier for the explicitly named Llama 2 family.

release_date.note: Public release date is explicit in both the announcement and version license; not inferred from repository creation.

open_weights.note: Meta released pretrained weights under license and access conditions; open weights does not mean an unrestricted license.

license.note: Custom license with conditional redistribution and commercial terms; not an Apache/MIT classification.

parameters_b.note: Fresh Meta model-card and technical-report checks confirm the exact pretrained model's nominal 70B total. Preserve the developer's published precision; no exact checkpoint tensor count is claimed.

active_parameters_b.note: Mistral's Mixtral paper Tables 2 and 4 explicitly list LLaMA 2 70B at 70B Active Params in base-model comparisons. DeepSeek-V2 Figure 1(a) corroborates approximately 70B activated parameters. The recorded value follows Mistral's nominal benchmark convention, not an inference from dense architecture or a Meta-authored exact per-token count. Meta's original card and report do not separately define active parameters or component participation.

architecture.note: Dense autoregressive Transformer is supported by the standard attention/SwiGLU implementation without routed experts; the paper specifically assigns GQA to 70B.

context_window.note: Original supported sequence length is explicitly 4096 tokens. Later extensions and code cache allocation defaults do not change the released context specification.

modalities.note: Original model card explicitly specifies text-only input and output.

reasoning.note: No dedicated reasoning mode is documented for this pretrained checkpoint. General reasoning benchmarks or prompted text completions do not establish such a feature.

tool_call.note: No native tool-call interface is documented for this base checkpoint. The paper discusses prompted tool emergence in Chat, so that finding is not transferred here.

description.note: The existing concise description correctly identifies the base pretrained release.

patch.notes: 70B total is Meta's nominal specification. The nominal 70B active count follows Mistral's Mixtral comparison tables, corroborated approximately by DeepSeek-V2; it is not a Meta disclosure of exact per-token participation. This is the original pretrained base model with GQA and 4,096-token context under the Llama 2 Community License. Dedicated reasoning and native tool-call support remain undocumented.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit confirms Meta's nominal 70B total and changes active parameters from undisclosed to verified nominal 70B using Mistral's original Mixtral Tables 2 and 4 for the exact Llama 2 70B base model. DeepSeek-V2 Figure 1(a) independently corroborates approximately 70B at plot precision. Reopened Meta's official card, original release card and full technical report; searched exact active/activated-count wording and later original comparisons. No separate Meta activation definition or exact tensor-participation count was found, and secondary search results were not used to establish the values. All twelve non-parameter assessments remain unchanged; no weights were downloaded or counted.
